title: This is a Phase 1/1b Study to Evaluate the Safety and Preliminary Antitumor Activity of LTZ-232 in Participants With Advanced/Metastatic Colorectal Cancer and Other Solid Tumors
official: A Phase 1/1b, Muticenter Study to Evaluate the Safety and Preliminary Antitumor Activity of LTZ-232 in Participants With Advanced/Metastatic Colorectal Cancer and Other Solid Tumors
summary: This is a first-in-human, Phase 1, multi-center, open-label study to characterize the safety, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, and preliminary anti tumor activity of LTZ-232 as monotherapy in adult participants with unresectable or metastatic colorectal cancer and other solid tumors failing standard therapies.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Advanced /metastatic colorectal tumors that have failed standard treatments
* Measurable disease per Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST v1.1)
* Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status (ECOG PS) ≤ 1
* Adequate organ function based on laboratory testing

Exclusion Criteria:

* Active infection with hepatitis B or C
* Uncontrolled CNS metastases
* Active autoimmune disease
* Clinically significant cardiovascular disease not adequately controlled with medication or impaired function
* Previous treatment with EpCAM targeting agent
* Pregnant or breast feeding
* Non-colorectal active malignancy within 3 years that could interfere with study interpretation
